rules.name: Candidate diameter exceeds compartment diameter
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when confirmed diameter exceeds confirmed compartment diameter.
rules.userMessage: The proposed coin cell is wider than the available compartment diameter.
rules.technicalReason: The battery cannot seat correctly when its diameter exceeds the compartment opening.
resolutionActions: Select a coin cell with a smaller diameter
Measure the compartment diameter or provide a clear compartment photo

rules.name: Candidate thickness exceeds compartment thickness
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when confirmed thickness exceeds confirmed compartment thickness.
rules.userMessage: The proposed coin cell is thicker than the available compartment space.
rules.technicalReason: Excess thickness can stop the cover from closing or overload the contact spring.
resolutionActions: Select a thinner coin cell
Measure the maximum compartment thickness

rules.name: Required contact arrangement is incompatible
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when the required contact arrangement does not match the candidate contact arrangement.
rules.userMessage: The contact arrangement does not match the compartment requirement.
rules.technicalReason: Incorrect contact geometry can prevent stable seating or correct physical connection.
resolutionActions: Use a coin cell with the required contact arrangement
Confirm the compartment contact arrangement

rules.name: Same diameter but greater thickness with unresolved clearance
rules.description: Flags a thicker same-diameter coin cell when clearance or contact pressure is not yet confirmed.
rules.userMessage: The coin cell may fit by diameter, but the extra thickness still needs contact-clearance confirmation.
rules.technicalReason: A thicker cell can alter spring pressure or cover closure even when the diameter matches.
resolutionActions: Confirm contact pressure or cover clearance before installation

rules.name: Family code recognition is supportive only
rules.description: Adds a note when family recognition supports the candidate relationship.
rules.userMessage: Shared family recognition can support a physical-fit review, but it is not final proof of fit.
rules.technicalReason: Coin cells with similar naming can still differ in thickness, contact design or other non-electrical fit details.

rules.name: Battery exceeds compartment length
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when confirmed battery length exceeds confirmed available compartment length.
rules.userMessage: The proposed battery is longer than the available compartment space.
rules.technicalReason: Excess length can prevent the battery from seating or being secured correctly.
resolutionActions: Select a shorter battery
Measure the available compartment length or provide a clear compartment photo

rules.name: Battery exceeds compartment width
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when confirmed battery width exceeds confirmed available compartment width.
rules.userMessage: The proposed battery is wider than the available compartment space.
rules.technicalReason: Excess width can stop the battery from seating correctly or interfere with surrounding parts.
resolutionActions: Select a narrower battery
Measure the available compartment width or provide a clear compartment photo

rules.name: Battery exceeds compartment height
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when confirmed battery height exceeds confirmed available compartment height.
rules.userMessage: The proposed battery is taller than the available compartment space.
rules.technicalReason: The battery may prevent the enclosure or cover from closing safely.
resolutionActions: Select a shorter battery
Measure the available compartment height or provide a clear compartment photo

rules.name: Terminal type is incompatible
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when the terminal type does not match the compartment requirement.
rules.userMessage: The terminal type does not match the required connection type.
rules.technicalReason: An incompatible terminal type can prevent safe physical connection.
resolutionActions: Use a battery with the required terminal type
Confirm the required terminal type before purchase

rules.name: Connector geometry is incompatible
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when the terminal layout does not match the required layout.
rules.userMessage: The terminal layout does not match the required connector geometry.
rules.technicalReason: Terminal layout mismatch can prevent safe cable routing and secure connection.
resolutionActions: Use a battery with the required terminal layout
Confirm the required terminal layout before installation

rules.name: Connector keying is incompatible
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when connector keying does not match the required connector keying.
rules.userMessage: The connector keying does not match the available connection hardware.
rules.technicalReason: Incorrect keying can stop the connector from seating correctly.
resolutionActions: Use a battery with matching connector keying
Confirm the connector keying with a clear terminal photo

rules.name: Polarity arrangement cannot be safely connected
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when polarity orientation does not match the required orientation.
rules.userMessage: The polarity orientation does not match the existing cable arrangement.
rules.technicalReason: Reversed polarity orientation can stop safe physical connection.
resolutionActions: Use a battery with the correct polarity orientation
Confirm the positive and negative terminal positions before installation

rules.name: Terminal position prevents safe connection
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when terminal position does not match the confirmed requirement.
rules.userMessage: The terminal position does not align with the available cable routing.
rules.technicalReason: Incorrect terminal placement can prevent safe connection without cable strain.
resolutionActions: Use a battery with matching terminal position
Confirm terminal position with a clear top-view photo

rules.name: Hold-down cannot safely secure the battery
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when hold-down type does not match the confirmed securing method.
rules.userMessage: The hold-down arrangement does not match the compartment securing method.
rules.technicalReason: A battery that cannot be secured correctly may move or vibrate during use.
resolutionActions: Use a battery with the correct hold-down arrangement
Confirm the hold-down style before purchase

rules.name: Cover cannot close
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when the battery height exceeds known cover clearance.
rules.userMessage: The battery appears too tall for the confirmed cover clearance.
rules.technicalReason: The cover or clamp may not close correctly when height exceeds known clearance.
resolutionActions: Select a battery with more top clearance
Confirm cover clearance before installation

rules.name: Cable requires unsafe stretching, crushing or modification
rules.description: Blocks a candidate when cable reach has been confirmed as unsafe.
rules.userMessage: The existing cable reach has been confirmed as unsuitable for this battery position.
rules.technicalReason: Unsafe cable routing can create strain, crushing or forced modification.
resolutionActions: Reject this battery candidate
Use a battery that aligns with the available cable reach

rules.name: Cable reach unclear
rules.description: Flags the candidate when cable reach has not yet been confirmed.
rules.userMessage: Cable reach must be confirmed before installation.
rules.technicalReason: Even when dimensions fit, unclear cable reach can stop safe installation.
resolutionActions: Confirm cable reach with a top-down installation photo or supplier review

rules.name: Terminal orientation unclear
rules.description: Flags the candidate when terminal position or orientation still needs confirmation.
rules.userMessage: Terminal orientation still needs confirmation.
rules.technicalReason: A battery can pass basic dimensions but still need a top-view terminal check.
resolutionActions: Provide a clear top-view battery photo or terminal diagram

rules.name: Hold-down type unknown
rules.description: Flags the candidate when the securing method is not yet confirmed.
rules.userMessage: The hold-down type still needs confirmation.
rules.technicalReason: Battery dimensions alone do not confirm secure mounting.
resolutionActions: Confirm the hold-down method with a compartment photo or supplier review

rules.name: Cover clearance close to known limit
rules.description: Flags the candidate when confirmed cover clearance is present but tight.
rules.userMessage: Cover clearance is close to the known limit and should be rechecked.
rules.technicalReason: Tight top clearance can be sensitive to clamp hardware, covers or measurement error.
resolutionActions: Recheck top clearance before purchase or installation

rules.name: Cover clearance unknown
rules.description: Flags the candidate when overall height appears acceptable but dedicated cover clearance has not been confirmed.
rules.userMessage: Cover clearance still needs confirmation.
rules.technicalReason: Available compartment height does not always confirm clamp or cover clearance.
resolutionActions: Confirm top cover clearance with a photo or direct measurement

rules.name: Compartment shape not fully confirmed
rules.description: Flags the candidate when the compartment shape or access path is not yet confirmed.
rules.userMessage: Compartment shape or access constraints still need confirmation.
rules.technicalReason: A battery can pass simple dimensions but still clash with nearby brackets, vents or access constraints.
resolutionActions: Confirm the compartment shape with a wider installation photo

rules.name: Same battery family but unresolved variant
rules.description: Flags a candidate when family recognition exists but the exact physical variant is not confirmed.
rules.userMessage: The battery family looks relevant, but the exact physical variant still needs confirmation.
rules.technicalReason: Family code recognition supports review but does not prove final fit across all variants.
resolutionActions: Confirm the exact family variant with supplier fitment evidence

rules.name: User measurement is approximate
rules.description: Flags the candidate when measurement evidence is approximate rather than confirmed.
rules.userMessage: Some measurements are approximate and should be confirmed.
rules.technicalReason: Approximate measurements reduce trust in a close-fit decision.
resolutionActions: Replace approximate measurements with direct confirmed measurements

rules.name: Terminal-view photo missing
rules.description: Flags the candidate when terminal position evidence is still missing.
rules.userMessage: A clear terminal-view photo would improve confidence in the fit result.
rules.technicalReason: Photo evidence can confirm terminal placement, clamp style and nearby obstructions.
resolutionActions: Provide a clear top-view battery and terminal photo

rules.name: Candidate has less unused clearance
rules.description: Adds a note when the confirmed clearances are small but still acceptable.
rules.userMessage: The battery fits within the confirmed dimensions but leaves less unused clearance.
rules.technicalReason: Tighter remaining clearance can matter during installation even when no blocking conflict is found.

rules.name: Battery weight differs
rules.description: Adds a note when the battery weight differs but no physical-fit conflict has been confirmed.
rules.userMessage: The battery weight differs from the current unit, even though no physical-fit conflict is confirmed here.
rules.technicalReason: Weight differences may affect handling or installation support hardware, but not necessarily fit.

rules.name: Case style differs without confirmed fit impact
rules.description: Adds a note when case style differs but the fit checks still pass.
rules.userMessage: The battery case style differs, but no physical-fit impact has been confirmed from the supplied information.
rules.technicalReason: Case appearance alone does not prove a fit issue when the key physical checks still pass.

rules.name: Family code recognition is supportive only
rules.description: Adds a note when family recognition supports the candidate relationship.
rules.userMessage: Family code recognition supports review, but it is not final proof of physical fit.
rules.technicalReason: Automotive family codes can still hide important differences in dimensions, terminals, hold-downs or case geometry.
